trust_decision.summary: Whether a caller-supplied cookie name/value/path/domain/expires string may contain CR/LF before it is stored as a Set-Cookie header value; decided (after the fix) only inside Response.set_cookie, with Response.write emitting header values verbatim.

landing_point.why: The advisory names Response.set_cookie(); the cookie string is concatenated at microdot.py:614-632 with no CR/LF check.

fix_sites.entry_point: public API Response.set_cookie() (also Response.delete_cookie(), Session.update/delete via cookie_options, Login remember cookie)
public API Response.redirect() / microdot.redirect (used by Login.login_user)
fix_sites.module_kind: core response helper; cosmetic rewrite of an existing check, no behaviour change

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: src/microdot/asgi.py:133-139 and src/microdot/wsgi.py:115-122 serialise res.headers themselves instead of calling Response.write (src/microdot/microdot.py:672-676); a fix placed in Response.write would not cover them. Not touched by the published fix.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Headers passed directly to Response(headers=...) or a tuple return, plus the reason phrase, are values the application sets itself, and under ASGI/WSGI the server is expected to validate them. The advisory names only set_cookie.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Cookie values and attributes legitimately contain ';', '=', spaces, commas and a formatted Expires date ('Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:01 GMT'), and Set-Cookie is a list emitted as several header lines. An over-broad fix that rejects ';' or ',', or that quotes or encodes values, breaks delete_cookie, JWT session cookies and multi-cookie responses.

O6_input_shapes: CR or LF in cookie value
CR or LF in name, expires string or partitioned/other attributes (covered because the check runs on the whole assembled string)

O7_producer.where: src/microdot/session.py:42-50 (Session cookie_options passed through to set_cookie at src/microdot/session.py:100-101 and :124)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Response(headers=...) and tuple returns (body, status, headers) emit arbitrary header values with no CR/LF check
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The developer sets those headers explicitly, unlike set_cookie's derived string; the advisory is scoped to set_cookie

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Custom reason phrase written into the status line unchecked (Response reason / abort reason)
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The status line is not a header, and the reason is usually a constant

O8_uncovered_routes.route: send_file content_type and compressed (string) values copied into headers unchecked
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: send_file arguments are documented as trusted (security note at :800-802)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: ASGI and WSGI adapters serialise all headers, including Set-Cookie, independently of Response.write
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The ASGI/WSGI server is responsible for header validation
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: other module in the same package

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a session helper that builds its own Set-Cookie string (e.g. extra attributes from cookie_options) and appends to response.headers directly instead of calling set_cookie
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Session already treats cookie options as a passthrough dict; a maintainer adding SameSite or another unsupported attribute could append it by hand.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: CORS headers built from configured or request-derived lists (expose_headers, Access-Control-Request-Headers echo) without CR/LF validation
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The values are reflected or joined into headers verbatim already; a config-sourced value is a natural place to skip validation.

O9_family: CWE-113 HTTP response splitting / header CRLF injection

O10_build.project_tests: tests/test_response.py (set_cookie and redirect tests around lines 180-250); tests for session/login/asgi/wsgi in tests/

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add a CR/LF check on the value argument only in set_cookie, leaving path/domain/name and the generic header and ASGI/WSGI serialisation paths open.

out_of_scope_notes: Cookie attribute injection via ';' in value (not CRLF) is not addressed by the fix; it is a different property.
The request header parser strips only the line ends (src/microdot/microdot.py:413-419), so a bare mid-line CR could reach reflected CORS headers (src/microdot/cors.py:95); not pursued.
unverified: repo_mb not measured; I judge it a small library under 5 MB of source (tiny_repo flag), but did not measure it.
Whether the docs promise header sanitisation everywhere was not checked.
No latest release was given, so present_in_latest is unknown for every route.
Whether typical ASGI/WSGI servers reject CRLF in header values (which would weaken the O2 site) is not verifiable offline here.
